Mr. Anurag Sharma - Dy. Govt. Advocate for respondent
ORDER The applicant has filed this second bail application u/S.483 of BNSS for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested by Police Station- Gulabganj, Vidisha, in connection with Crime No.66/2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 120-B, 467, 468, 471 and 201 of IPC and Section 7(ga),
13(1)(d) and 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he, acting in concert with other co-accused persons, diverted funds (Rs.2,35,947/-) from the account of the Mandi Samiti to his relatives.
Consequently, the aforementioned offence was registered.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that false case has been registered against the applicant and he is suffering confinement since 13.01.2026.
There is no direct evidence connecting the applicant with the transfer of the alleged amount to his relatives.
The applicant is ready and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:7902 2 MCRC-5013-2026 willing to deposit the amount alleged by the prosecution before the Trial Court.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make himself available as and when required.
He would abide by the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.
Learned PP for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of this application.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail subject to deposit Rs.2,35,947/- (Rupees Two Lac, Thirty Five Thousand and Nine hundred and forty seven) before the Trial Court and on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
It is made clear that the amount of Rs.2,35,947/- which shall be deposited by the applicant before the Trial Court, shall be disbursed to the complainant/aggrieved person i.e. Mandi Samiti.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJESH KUMAR GUPTA ) JUDGE (LJ*)
